reasoning: The question asks if Tesla will discontinue the Cybertruck before April 1, 2026. As of the forecast date (March 6, 2026), there are only 26 days remaining. Recent evidence from February 2026 shows Tesla actively introducing a cheaper Cybertruck model ($59,990) and cutting prices on the Cyberbeast, indicating continued commitment to the product line. While sales have declined 48% in 2025 and the vehicle faces challenges, Tesla is taking corrective pricing actions rather than discontinuing it. No credible sources indicate Tesla has announced discontinuation or removed ordering capability from their website. The evidence shows active product development and market repositioning, not discontinuation.
